focus: Check whether the live qga socket is simply missing a host listener or whether it is already present as a qemu-owned listening socket when direct host-side connect still fails.
findings: Host-side `ss -xlpn` shows the live qga path `/run/user/1000/libvirt/qemu/run/channel/1-regprobe-win11-25h2-/org.qemu.guest_agent.0` as `LISTEN` under `qemu-system-x86` pid 8704 fd 107.

A matching `lsof -U -a -p 8704` snapshot also shows the same live qga path as `type=STREAM (LISTEN)` under the same qemu process, while the sibling monitor socket is simultaneously present under that same pid.
Direct host-side AF_UNIX connect to the live qga path still returns `ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')` even though the socket is visible as a qemu-owned `LISTEN` endpoint.

Direct host-side connect to the sibling qemu monitor socket does not return `ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')`; it instead returns `BlockingIOError(11, 'Resource temporarily unavailable')`, so the qga path is failing differently from another live qemu-owned listening socket on the same process.
